role: prior-published consistency evidence; not a new PAYOFF confirmatory test

published_model2_bird_speed.interpretation: bird migration speed itself changes with green-up timing and green-up propagation speed

published_model3_species_traits.interpretation: published timing sensitivity does not show the negative association with migration speed expected from a simple timing-for-speed tradeoff; its point estimate is positive but the interval overlaps zero

source_definitions.xi_mean: posterior mean species-specific sensitivity (days/day) to green-up for each cell

synthesis_with_registered_holdout.licensed_statement: The source study and the fresh split-sample holdout both fail to support a simple tradeoff in which stronger timing responsiveness reduces reliance on migration-speed matching.
synthesis_with_registered_holdout.prohibited_statement: Do not claim positive timing-movement complementarity from the unsupported positive holdout interaction or the positive-but-uncertain published species-sensitivity coefficient.
